title: Resolution moves an on-board unit for free instead of playing a hand unit at -3 cost to a controlled battlefield
expected: Card def (riftbound-cards/src/cards/sfd/here-to-help.ts:15-21) declares {type:'play', from:'hand', reduceCost:{energy:3}, toLocation:{battlefield:'controlled'}, target:{controller:'friendly',type:'unit'}}. Engine mishandles all three: (1) play-spell.ts:465-471/567 treats the friendly-unit descriptor as a board card target (no exclusion for play/from:'hand', unlike chain/resolve.ts:155), so cast-time enumeration binds an on-board friendly unit; (2) abilities/effects/play.ts:32 only gathers hand candidates when `from==='hand' && !ctx.boundTargets`, so with the bound board unit it falls to getTargetIds (line 50) and then lines 74-87 push a triggered {type:'move', target, to:'choose'} chain item — toLocation object {battlefield:'controlled'} is neither 'here' nor 'base' so dest='choose' (line 74), no controlled-battlefield restriction; (3) `reduceCost` is never read in play.ts (only referenced in effects/look.ts:38-48), and the move path pays no cost at all. Matches observed: existing unit moved for free with unrestricted destination, hand untouched.
observed: Resolution put a triggered 'move <target> to: choose' item on the chain, then a choose-destination pendingChoice. Normal cast: Flame Chompers (already in base) was moved base -> battlefield, options offered were BOTH battlefields including the uncontrolled enemy one; hand unchanged, no energy/power spent beyond the spell's own cost. From hidden: Gust Monk (already at that battlefield) was auto-selected with no prompt and offered destinations 'base' or the opponent's uncontrolled battlefield; picked base and it moved there. No unit was ever played from hand and no cost reduction occurred. (handle_play in abilities/effects/play.ts ignores from:'hand', reduceCost and toLocation:{battlefield:'controlled'}.)
